concerns.text: The 'Metric note' and T004/T005 make the sign-preserving mean correlation the PRIMARY outcome, but the project constitution Principle VII mandates connectivity strength be quantified as the mean ABSOLUTE correlation across DMN edges. No task implements the constitutionally-required primary metric; T004 computes strength_absolute only as a 'descriptive secondary'. Either a task must compute the absolute-correlation primary outcome, or the constitution must be amended — as written, the task list cannot satisfy Principle VII.
